title: Marvelous Designer 2025 Shanghai User Conference Guest Speech Review p01 CLO Founder Jaden Marvelous Designer: Growing Together with Users
description:
Thank you to all the guests for their wonderful speeches and valuable insights at the Marvelous Designer 2025 Shanghai User Conference!

During this conference, we delved into the powerful appeal of Marvelous Designer in game production and virtual creation. The presentations covered practical tips for designing game character costumes, as well as a special explanation of how Marvelous Designer interacts with the Unreal Engine to enhance the realism of virtual clothing, from the shared growth between Marvelous Designer and its users to the stunning release of new features in 2025.

Don't miss out on these exciting contents!

In fact, there are the most Chinese users in the world who use Marvelous Designer (MD). It is an honor to have this talk in this place. Today, I will explain how we have developed MD by interacting with users like you and what direction we will develop MD in the future. ## Origins of Marvelous Designer First of all, I will explain how we started. I studied real-time costume simulation around 2006. As you can see in the picture, real-time costume simulation is possible, and real-time costume editing is also possible. This is the real-time simulation that I developed in 2006. At that time, you could edit the costume version. After graduation, I thought about what to do with this and decided to start a company very easily. The biggest reason was that I saw students enjoying using this simple software in class. It was the happiest moment for me, so I decided to improve it further. I started my business in 2009, and the first version of Marvelous Designer was released in 2010. ## The First Version of Marvelous Designer As you can see, this is the first version of Marvelous Designer that we released in 2010. If you look at Marvelous Designer at the bottom, you can make clothes with 10 different tools. Even with just these 10 tools, you can create draping, patterns, and sewing. The reaction from the CG team was very positive. At that time, in 2010, we had to use very professional tools to make clothes, but with our tool, if you designed patterns and pressed the simulation button, the production was very realistic. Many people liked it. ## Development Through User Feedback From 2011, we started using Marvelous Designer in D&D, and after that, we began to use it in many other projects. Between 2013 and 2015, we focused on improving usability, such as freezing, deactivating, strengthening, and tech features. Thanks to this tool, we were able to create a very creative image. Users became more familiar with the tools and began to have more accurate and realistic ideas about how to create their own clothes. I believe I learned much more good things from KTO than when I was learning about your clothes. I was more interested in graphic textures when I was growing up, and I've learned positive things about my style. Therefore, we developed many functions, such as LED paneling. ## Expanding User Needs As users asked for more features beyond modeling, we recognized there were areas that could not be addressed in MD, such as topology, rigging, and animation. Additionally, users expressed a desire to integrate their designs with other tools. As we implemented MD, new needs emerged for connecting with external software. In this way, the technology improved, and the number of users continued to grow, especially in China, which has the largest user market. Here, we are growing the product by receiving feedback from various media channels, such as Weibo. Because of the large number of users, MD can continue to grow as it is now. ## Recognition and Awards We achieved significant recognition by winning the Science and Technology Award at the Academy Awards last year. This award is a testament to the recognition our product has received. ## Future Development Directions Now, let’s discuss the future development direction of MD. Our thought process and direction are essential. As we have done so far, your feedback will have a significant impact on our development trajectory. We conduct many surveys and receive feedback through various channels, including WeChat. Today's user summit is a great opportunity to gather your insights. Based on this feedback, we have decided on the next four development directions for MD: ### 1. All-in-One Integration Our first direction is to create an all-in-one tool. Not only will we focus on modeling, but we will also implement animation, rigging, and topology in our tool. ### 2. Usability Improvement We are continually improving the usability of our tool, focusing on simulation speed, trip simulation, and various speeds of work. ### 3. Asset Utilization The third development direction is to enhance how users find and utilize assets. Clothing is not only made up of patterns but also requires materials like fabric and buttons. We aim to make it easier to access these materials. ### 4. Rich Material Availability Lastly, we plan to provide a rich variety of materials in our digital mall to enhance clothing production efficiency. ## New Features and Enhancements ### Animation Editor We have introduced an animation editor that allows for keyframe animation. Users can animate material properties, such as color, wind, gravity, and other simulation properties. Additionally, the avatar's motion and poses can be set as keyframes, enabling more freedom in animation. ### QuadMesh Functionality We have improved the QuadMesh functionality. Unlike previous versions, the next version will automatically create QuadMesh without issues, enhancing overall performance. ### Automatic Rigging Recent developments include a feature for automatic rigging of costumes. While automatic rigging sometimes requires adjustments, we are dedicated to continuously updating this feature based on user feedback. ### UV Mapping Control We have enhanced the control of mesh thickness and UV mapping, allowing for more precise control directly within Marvelous Designer, eliminating the need for external tools. ### Usability Enhancements We have improved the usability and efficiency of Marvelous Designer by enhancing the speed of draping simulations. The stability and speed of GPU simulations have also improved significantly. ## Integration with External Tools We are enhancing compatibility with external tools and services. Notably, we have improved the integration with ZBrush, allowing for seamless content transfer between MD and ZBrush. ## Linux Support Lastly, we are excited to announce that we will be supporting the Red Hat Enterprise Linux version with ROCKY this year, addressing the long-standing requests from enterprise users. ## Conclusion In conclusion, we have prepared detailed explanations of how to use these functions in the afternoon session. If you have any questions or want to learn more about the new features, please join us for a detailed introduction and discussions with our technical staff. Thank you!
